experiments.hypothesis: Hard-asserted trial 0 values: {"advice_slice_hits": 1, "advice_w16_is_g": 1, "advice_w17": 1, "classes": 728, "fibre": 1019866814, "fibre_dfs_ops": 1944, "fibre_shift": 97451488, "g16_fibre_size": 2, "g17_fibre_size": 1, "groups": 200, "ops_per_cand": 411, "sample_trail": 200, "sample_valid": 200, "sample_w16_one_value": 1, "sample_w9_shifted": 200, "sfs_collision": 1}. Trials 1 to 255 require transplant_ok = w1_is_u = w16_identity = 1 with a listed entry of the fibre 0x3cc9eebe in place of the advice (a2, a3); trial 1 also emits the advice-construction values. H8 arm, asserted after trial 3 on the 2 windows pooled, each |z| <= 3 (bands derived and calibrated on fresh local seeds before any public-seed run, proof Appendix I): B1 (panel-derived) distinct F9 claws per distinct claw p9 = 907.1667 / 57,003.18: z = (F - 0.0159143 C) / sqrt(0.01829 C); B2 (panel-derived) F8-passing entries per F9 claw on the 4 groups, centre rho x 682,431.7 = 6838.16 with rho = 0.010020 measured on set A against the exact whole-list count: z = (N4/F - 6838.16) / sqrt(15510000.0/F + 1202.0); B3 (local, not a 2^26 transfer) distinct claws: z = (C - 2 x 1261.8) / (sqrt(2) x 34.23). h8_Y4 (capped yield) is recorded, not asserted: its band failed calibration (Appendix I). A failed band falsifies the transfer it names.
experiments.scope: Advice collision and construction checks (fibres, inversion, 256-candidate slice); for one entry of each of the 200 groups at the advice point: the rule, W9 = advice W9 + 0x05cefde0, one W16 value, the two-message trail through step 16. No claw of the advice itself (it is not on the fibre). Not an ordinary fixed-IV certificate. Trials 2 and 3 also run the H8 arm (research PREDECLARE_H8_1117.txt; proof Appendix I): per trial one window of 2^22 walk evaluations of the shipped program law on that trial's organizer seed (screen on, k4 on, no work cap, the 4-group entries diagnostic k4_ib = 7), its guards and k4 evaluations stamped as r39k4-window-small trial 1 stamps them (shared helper _stamp). Per window: distinct claws C, distinct F9 claws F, the F8-passing listed entries N4 of the F9 claws over groups 0, 50, 100, 150 (98,112 of the 9,701,592 entries; exact count), the same for the claws with stamp <= Wc = 30,858,481 (kappa x mean set-A 2^22 window work, kappa = W_max / mean 2^26 work), the sum of squares of the per-claw N4 and the window's operations (h8_C, h8_F, h8_N4, h8_Y4, h8_Q4, h8_ops). Seeds, window size, groups and bands were fixed before any public-seed run; nothing is seed-pinned, so a holdout nonce runs the arm unchanged.

experiments.hypothesis: Hard-asserted in r39joint_k4.py._k4e on the organizer seeds of trials 0-3, windows run with the screen off (screen=0; the k4 path is the same code with the screen on): (claws, F9, 0, pass lanes, survivors, key hits, k4 ops, total ops) = (233,7,0,436800,2,0,900202,11413695), (222,11,0,624000,5,0,1285655,13735425), (256,4,0,249600,2,0,513639,12989110), (232,1,0,62400,0,0,124538,11254554) (K4_WIN_EXP); k4 ops are the asserted values above (the position-22 early exit shortens the W17 pass and the k4 guards add 2 operations each; an F9 claw costs at most 143,633 + 480 + its guards); every F9 claw asserts W9 = C9 + 0x05cefde0 - a1 = W9 of a listed entry and W16 = g; pass-off identity on trial 0 (the guards of the k4-only sites excluded); trial 1 records each completed claw's stamp (running max of m.o + R over its charged guards, diagnostics excluded) in its own k4 run, reruns the window capped at the middle stamp W and asserts the capped run completes exactly the claws with stamp <= W and stops within 65,536 operations below W (stamp_claws, stamp_kept, stamp_W); for the first F9 claw of each trial and each of the 200 groups a planted key is found and its cost asserted ('k4 plant'); k4_setup = 1,107,473,556. Key dispersion over all entries of groups 0, 50, 100, 150: per F9 claw D = keys with an entry in F8, K = those with W17 x 2654435761 mod 2^32 top 7 bits zero; K ~ Binomial(D, 2^-7) under independence. Accept if sum D >= 96,821, |sum K - sum D/128| within 2.576 s.d., Pearson < 40.29 (22 dof). Asserted per trial (sum D, sum K, Pearson, claws): (59,256, 437, 6.5188, 7); (67,492, 518, 7.9839, 10); (17,882, 142, 0.7772, 4); (1,872, 7, 4.0067, 1). Screened window (trial 0, same seed, screen on as on the attack path): asserted not skipped, kept chaining value with S <= 5, every first-block draw charged 187 operations (kept) or 190 (discarded), and the discarded-draw count equal to the number of draws with S > 5 (12 draws, 11 discarded, kept S = 1); no new output key.
experiments.scope: Trials 0 to 3 run 4 windows of 2^21 walk evaluations of the shipped program, k4 and check mode on. On every F9 claw the counted W17 pass runs over all 62,400 prefix lanes of the 200 groups; planted checks and the diagnostic then run with the counter restored; the list is generated at import by rule and asserted by its counts; trial 0 is re-run with k4 off; trial 0 also runs one window with the a3eb4a8a screen on; trial 1 also runs one capped window (cap = its middle claw stamp). Claw-selection arm of H-cross-claw (trials 0, 2, 3; proof Appendix H): on each real F9 claw of the window, 4,000 entries of group sd mod 200, each F8-passing one a real trial (W17 set to the advice value, W0 re-solved so W16 stays g) paired with a virtual trial on the same chaining value (W8 in F8, W9 in F9 uniform, class 01); observations xr_n, xr18, xv18 (row 18 passes). Prediction, asserted after trial 3: pooled (xr18 - xv18)^2 <= 4.5 xr_n (|z| <= 3).

experiments.hypothesis: Prediction (falsifiable, hard-asserted): at every verified tail collision of a real listed entry of the fibre 0x3cc9eebe, no other F8-passing listed entry of the same key (same a2 and kappa), compressed on the same claw with its own words k4_words(cv, a0, a1, a2, a3_j), follows the advice XOR state differences past row 19 (through19 = 0). Prediction on the hits' W3 (not an observation field: the W3 values are in the run's full record, which the observation digest48 pins and proof Appendix E prints; checked over r39-mate-01..14 together, not asserted in code): at most two of the 14 runs' hits have W3 in the union of the sets B_d = {W3 : s0(W3 + d) - s0(W3) - d is a nonzero element of P - P} over the 20 mate offsets d of the list, P the W18 values admitting the advice differences through row 19 (explicit conditions and enumeration program in proof Appendix D; 543,840 W3 values in all), expected 0.24 if W3 were uniform, falsified at 3 or more; and the per-bit chi-square of the hits' W3 (32 bits, ones against half the hits) is below 62.49 at 32 df (the 99.9% point). Organizer-recorded observations of trial 0 (numbers only): log2_carrier, hits, mates, mates_f8, through19 (the prediction above: 0), carrier_w18_clusters, cluster_sum_sq, and digest48 = 30968015985539 (0x1c2a4d979b83), the first 48 bits of the sha256 of the run's full record, hard-asserted for this id (proof Appendix E prints the record). Cross-claw test (premise H-cross-claw, proof Section 7 and Appendix H): for every hit, 32 virtual trials on another claw of the hit's chaining value (arm A) and 32 on a fresh random chaining value (arm U); observations xc_n (trials per arm), xa18/xu18 (row 18 kept the advice XOR differences), xa20/xu20 (the advice XOR differences held through row 19). Prediction (falsifiable, stated before the run): over r39-mate-01..14 together, sum xa20 <= 17; 18 or more falsifies it (the one-sided 99% bound on the per-trial rate would exceed 2^-11 and eps_key = 2^-8 be unsupported).
experiments.scope: The unchanged tail replica (the bare raw-string statement that ends experiments/r39joint_k4.py, which serve() reads back from the file and runs in its own namespace for these ids: w13's r39tail.py verbatim but for its final main-guard line and its main() (dead here, removed), then the mate code: start state, SMC carrier rows 18..23, collision test rows 24..38, full verification); each batch of 2,048 lanes carries one listed entry, uniform over the 9,701,592 entries (4 kappa groups per run drawn with probability proportional to size and asserted against the rule's enumeration, then a uniform group of the 4 and a uniform entry in it per batch), which sets W10 and W11; the lanes' W8 and W9 are the replica's own draws in F8 and F9, so (a0, a1) follow the claw model H1 with a0 of either parity. 6 chunks x 80 batches x 2,048 lanes.
